text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert surge detected: k8s-api-client-errors triggered 12x in last 5m. Maintenance window starting now in us-west2 (infra-team). Paging primary.

Maya: I'm primary oncall. I'm seeing a noisy spike from kube-apiserver healthchecks — lots of 503s to model-serving nodes but not seeing an uptick in public 5xx yet. @Arjun are you available as secondary?

Arjun: I'm secondary and available. Confirm maintenance start at 10:02 PT. Proposal: suppress noisy alert and temporarily relax SLO alert thresholds for the maintenance window so we don't page on expected noise. Keep customer-facing 5xx alerts intact.

Lena: Heads up — I have a calendar conflict 11:00-12:00 PST (support training). We have a coverage gap for part of that hour unless someone picks it up.

Theo: I can cover 11:00-11:45. Set me as secondary for that window.

Maya: @incident-bot can we mute k8s-api-client-errors for 2h or add a suppression? We'll keep critical inference-5xx alerts live.

incident-bot: Suppression requested by Maya. To approve, ping @Jess (sre lead). Use: `/ops suppress-alert k8s-api-client-errors --duration=2h --note="maintenance noise"`

Jess: SRE lead here — approve temporary suppression for 2h. Do NOT suppress customer-inference-5xx or model-inference-5xx alerts. Also please bump 'for' and threshold on the noisy rule rather than blanket mute so runbooks still trigger on genuine regressions.

Maya: I'll apply a temporary rule tweak. Patch snippet I plan to use:
```yaml
alert: K8sApiErrorHighNoise
expr: rate(k8s_apiserver_request_errors[5m]) > 150
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/k8s-api-noise
```
Plan: increase `for` to 15m and threshold to 200 for the maintenance window.

Arjun: Confirming I'll help apply and watch. I'll also spin up a quick dashboard panel for the oncall to monitor error rate + client 5xx: <https://grafana/redwood/d/Ops/surges?orgId=1>

ops-bot: Alert suppression applied: k8s-api-client-errors for 2h by Maya. Override id=ovr-7823. Will auto-revert at 1823460500.

Maya: Quick customer impact check: support queue shows a small bump in retries but no increase in public API 5xx. query 'inference_5xx_rate' looks flat on the last 30m. I'll attach snapshots to the incident timeline.

Arjun: Noted. I'm updating runbook pointers to reflect the temporary change: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff — note: 'temporary alert tweak active, override ovr-7823, maintenance us-west2'.

Lena: Thanks. Theo will cover my meeting slot. @Maya add me back if anything escalates.

Maya: Handoff summary: primary = Maya, secondary = Theo (11:00-11:45), backup = Arjun. Coverage gap 11:45-12:00 — Jess can you cover that last 15m? If not I'll extend suppression.

Jess: I can cover 11:45-12:00 if needed. Also request: please file a short post-ops note after the window so we can decide if permanent alert tuning is warranted.

Maya: :thumbsup: Action log so far — applied override ovr-7823, created dashboard graf-992, updated runbooks and handoff notes. Will revert override at the end of maintenance and post before/after SLO snapshots.

incident-bot: Reminder: suppression ovr-7823 will auto-revert at 1823460500. Manual revert allowed if maintenance finishes earlier.

Maya: Will confirm manual revert if maintenance ends early and post closure. Closing handoff thread — if escalation happens page all-sre. Otherwise I'll post closure + action items.

Theo: I'll keep pager on for my window. ping me if any new 5xx shows up.
